text:
sam: FYI planning a controlled toggle of recommendation_v3 in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. will do a canary then quick ramp if stable.

leah: outline the ramp and rollback signals so on-call knows what to watch.

sam: plan: 0% -> 5% (10m) -> 20% (15m) -> 60% (15m) -> 100% (cooldown 20m). immediate drain if error spike or CTR drop. thresholds below.

jorge: prefer pinning the canary to model rev rec-model-v3-2026-03-10. Otherwise A/B noise from model swap.

sam: agree. adding pin and an explicit fallback rev. also enabling a soft-queue limit for the canary cohort to avoid head-of-line if warmups hit.

```
# rollout config
flag: recommendation_v3
cohorts:
  - name: canary
    percent: 5
    pinned_revision: rec-model-v3-2026-03-10
  - name: ramp
    percent: 20
safety:
  error_rate_threshold: 0.01
  ctr_drop_pct: 5
  single_window_fail: 0.02
fallback_revision: rec-model-v2-2026-02-28
```

tina: tagging infra to ensure the canary pool has at least 2 spare gpu nodes for warmups. pinging ops.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by sam for service=recs-api commit=def5678 tag=release/2026-03-22. Canary pinned to rec-model-v3-2026-03-10. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-22/notes

oncall-bot: Reminder: on-call set to monitor recs p95, error-rate, and CTR cohorts for the next 3h. Alert thresholds set to configured safety values.

leah: emergency action item: if CTR drops >5% sustained across two windows OR error_rate spikes to >=2% in any 5m window, deploy-bot should auto-drain to fallback_revision and notify #incidents.

sam: adding that rule now. also request a short blurb in release notes explaining pin and fallback.

deploy-bot: Safety rule added: single-window error_rate >= 0.02 -> auto-drain + pin to rec-model-v2-2026-02-28. sustained CTR drop rule configured (2 windows). Notifications: #incidents and @oncall.

jorge: smoke tests ready. I'll run the evaluation harness and post quick metrics.

jorge: smoke results (canary 5%): error_rate=0.3%, p95 latency -8ms, CTR delta +0.4%. no regressions. link: https://redwood.internal/evals/3332101234

leah: looks good. proceed to 20%.

sam: shifting to 20% now. will watch the cohort heatmap and qps.

deploy-bot: Rollout advanced to 20% at +25m. snapshot: error_rate=0.45%, p95 +5ms, CTR delta +0.2%.

tina: infra: canary pool warmed, autoscaler headroom OK. small note: queue depth peeked, we kept soft-queue limit.

leah: proceed to 60% after 15m if metrics stable. no objections?

jorge: no objections.

sam: moving to 60%.

deploy-bot: Advanced to 60% at +45m. snapshot: error_rate=0.6%, p95 +12ms, CTR delta -0.8% (within 5%).

leah: CTR dip is small and within threshold but watch closely. set manual hold if it crosses 2% drop.

oncall-bot: Alert rule: if CTR drop >= 5% in two consecutive windows -> auto-drain.

sam: cooldown now, waiting 20m then 100% if stable.

deploy-bot: Reached 100% at +1h5m. final metrics: error_rate=0.65%, p95 +14ms, CTR delta -0.9%. No auto-drain triggered.

jorge: running post-rollout full eval. posting results in 20m.

leah: release notes updated: "recommendation_v3 behind flag. Canary pinned to rec-model-v3-2026-03-10. Fallback: rec-model-v2-2026-02-28. Auto-drain on error_rate >=2% (single window) or sustained CTR drop >=5% (2 windows)."

tina: ops follow-up: leaving the pin for 48h, schedule unpin after model validation run on 2026-03-24.

sam: thanks. cc @oncall for 3h watch. I'll file a short deployment note in the release doc.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release/2026-03-22. Audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/3332101234

leah: small retrospective: next time we can experiment with a 10% canary step to reduce rollout time if metrics stable.

sam: agreed. closing thread unless any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
